title: Main International
description: THE MAIN INTERNATIONAL art for theatrical posters for THE EMPIRE STRIKES BACK (front) was painted by famed Japanese illustrator Noriyoshi Ohrai. While keeping the general design theme of an overpowering Darth Vader and the embrace between Princess Leia and Han Solo, like many foreign posters, it contains more design elements, space hardware and action. The design was used in Japan (back), Australia and many European countries.
